evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet transaction creation and PSBT signing logic across spend and signing files.
rationale: Allows skipping script paths during Taproot spending to save fees and avoid leaking fallback scripts. As Sjors notes, Taproot descriptors with fallback scripts unnecessarily add and sign script-path data, exposing scripts and risking accidental broadcast; this opt-in parameter provides a clean mechanism to suppress script-path handling for advanced setups like MuSig2.
